title: Invariance Under Equivalent Propositions
statement: For a fixed nondeterministic register machine, oracle, input, guard, and configuration, if the configuration satisfies the termination and acceptance semantics for proposition $P$, and $P$ is logically equivalent to $Q$, then it satisfies those semantics for $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The configuration has the stated semantics for $P$
